title: Threads of Fate
next_chapter_hook: Ling Yuan stepped out from the shadows, his face carrying a chilling smile: 'Chen Ji, did you think faking your death could deceive me? The prince and the sect have jointly issued a kill order.'

text.content: Chen Nian's fingertips trembled as she pointed toward the invisible void. Her pupils reflected countless light threads as fine as spider silk, as if fate itself was being unraveled. 'Brother, I see... your fate... there's more than one thread.' Her voice was soft, yet each word struck like thunder.

dialogue.content: Chen Nian grabbed Chen Ji's sleeve abruptly, her fingers terrifyingly cold. 'There are two threads... extending from your heart... one connects to the Heavenly Celestial Eye, that thing is sucking your luck! The other...' Her voice cut off abruptly, her face turning ashen, 'the other connects to a pair of even more ancient eyes, more terrifying than the Heavenly Celestial Eye!'

text.content: Chen Ji's heart stirred with alarm. The Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea trembled slightly, as if sensing something. He suppressed the surging waves in his heart, his voice growing even more calm: 'Tell me slowly, what are those ancient eyes? What do they want?'

dialogue.content: Chen Nian's eye sockets reddened, yet she forced herself to continue: 'They're confronting each other... like two people playing chess, and you are the piece on the board. The Heavenly Celestial Eye is pulling you, those ancient eyes are supporting you... Brother, they're fighting over you!' Tears finally slipped from the corners of her eyes, 'I don't know which side is good, which side is evil...'

text.content: Chen Ji reached out and wiped the tears from his sister's face. When his fingertips touched her skin, he felt an unusual warmth—the price of glimpsing the Threads of Fate. He suddenly remembered Mo Xiansheng's words: the Tianji Record is the chessboard, not a chess piece. But now he saw clearly that he was clearly a chess piece being contested on the board.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji asked softly, his tone terrifyingly calm: 'The Heavenly Celestial Eye and those ancient eyes, what is their relationship? Are they enemies or allies?' His tone was tranquil, but his mind was racing rapidly—if the Heavenly Celestial Eye embodied the will of Heaven, then what force did eyes surpassing Heaven represent?

Chen Nian took a deep breath, trying to calm herself: 'They are rivals... like two groups of people playing chess. The Heavenly Celestial Eye is one side's chess player, those ancient eyes are the other side's chess player. Brother, the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion mark on you... is a chess piece of the latter.' She raised her head, her gaze complex, 'The Heavenly Secrets Pavilion... belongs to those ancient eyes.'

text.content: Heavenly Secrets Pavilion. The three characters struck like three thunderbolts, exploding in Chen Ji's mind. Mo Xiansheng had been a remnant soul guardian of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion, and the Tianji Record was the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion's supreme treasure—so it was like this. The Tianji Record Fragment had not fallen into his hands by chance, but was a chess piece strategically placed by those ancient eyes. He suddenly wanted to laugh, yet felt his spine grow cold.

dialogue.content: Chen Nian suddenly furrowed her brows, as if peering toward an even more distant place: 'Wait... deep within the temporal rift... there's a third thread!' Her voice suddenly rose sharply, 'It twines together with your thread, almost merging into one... that's... that's Father's!'

text.content: Chen Tianming. Chen Ji's fists slowly tightened within his sleeves. His father, missing for years—the 'criminal' who supposedly 'betrayed the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion'—his Thread of Fate had actually been twined with his own all along? Deep within the temporal rift, what did this mean? Was he there? Was he alive or dead?

dialogue.content: Chen Nian's gaze followed that faint, barely visible thread, her expression growing more focused: 'Father's thread is very faint... like a dying candle in the wind... but it's still burning. He's in a very, very deep place, Brother, he's waiting for you...' Before she could finish, her body suddenly stiffened, 'Something... is severing my—'

text.content: A trickle of blood slid from Chen Nian's nose tip, shocking in the moonlight. Her face instantly turned deathly pale, her body swaying as she fell backward. Chen Ji caught her shoulder swiftly, a surging wave of fury welling up in his heart—someone didn't want Chen Nian to continue looking!

dialogue.content: Chen Ji asked in a low voice, his tone terrifyingly calm: 'Niannian, who severed your thread? What did you see?' His gaze was like a blade, sweeping across the surrounding darkness. His heart was already rapidly deducing possible candidates—whoever could interfere with Threads of Fate was at least an old monster of the彼岸境界...

Chen Nian clutched her nose, her voice weak yet carrying a thread of terror: 'One... my Thread of Fate was severed... someone's making moves in secret, not wanting me to see more... Brother, I can feel... that person is nearby... he's been watching us this whole time!'

choice.prompt: Chen Ji sensed a gaze watching from the darkness. The enemy had already acted to sever Chen Nian's thread. He had to make a decision immediately.

choices.text: Protect Chen Nian with all his might
choices.description: Position Chen Nian behind him, defend instead of attack, first ensure his sister's safety, then investigate the person in hiding.
choices.risk_hint: May fall into a passive position

text.content: Chen Ji positioned Chen Nian behind him, forming a seal with one hand. A mysterious formation rune pattern glowed around the two of them. His movements flowed like clouds and water, as if he had practiced them thousands of times. 'Don't be afraid, Brother is here.' His voice was soft, yet carried unwavering resolve.

dialogue.content: Chen Nian leaned against her brother's back, feeling that warm back, and a sour bitterness welled up in her heart. Growing up, it had always been her protecting others, and at this moment, she could finally be protected once too. 'Brother...' her voice choked.

choices.description: Attack instead of defend, use the power of the Tianji Record to trace back and locate whoever cut the thread, striving to seize the initiative.

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes turned cold, his fingers tracing a sinister rune in the void. The Tianji Record Fragment violently trembled within his Mental Sea, as an inexplicable power surged backward along the trajectory of the fate thread. 'Trying to run?' A cold smile curled at the corner of his lips. 'Show yourself!'

dialogue.content: In the distant darkness, a thread suddenly violently trembled. Chen Ji saw it—a thread as dark as ink, emanating a nauseating evil aura. At the source of the thread, a blurred figure was rapidly retreating. 'That's him...' Chen Nian weakly cried out, 'I recognize that thread... It's Ling Yuan!'

text.content: Ling Yuan. That name slipped across Chen Ji's heart like a venomous snake flicking its tongue. The former Sect Master of Tianqing Sect, the old senior who had shown such 'kind protection' toward Chen Ji—had apparently been secretly monitoring them all along. No wonder every time his plans encountered problems, there had always been another pair of eyes watching.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that smile carrying a hint of sarcasm: 'Ling Yuan, since you're already here, why hide and skulk? Thinking that cutting one thread from my sister can frighten me off? You underestimate Chen Ji.' His voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly carried into the depths of the night.

text.content: The night wind suddenly rose, and an elderly figure slowly walked out from the shadows. Ling Yuan's silver hair gleamed coldly under the moonlight, his face bearing a kind smile while his eyes were as cold and sinister as a venomous snake. 'Chen Ji ah Chen Ji, you truly are extraordinary. I hid for so long, yet you still discovered me.'

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan stood with hands behind his back, a flicker of sharp light passing through his turbid old eyes: 'You think faking death could deceive me? The prince and the sect have jointly issued a kill order—Tianqing Sect Outer Disciple Chen Ji, colluding with the Demonic Path, unpardonable crime.' His voice was like icy cold, 'Surrender the Tianji Record obediently, and I can give you a swift death.'

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan finally revealed himself, baring his fangs. Chen Ji faces a choice: fight head-on or continue to endure?

choices.description: No longer hide strength, expose Ling Yuan's conspiracy on the spot, and turn his own methods against him.
choices.visible_reward: Publicly humiliate Ling Yuan, reputation greatly increased

text.content: Chen Ji stepped forward, an elegant smile appearing on his refined face: 'Ling Yuan, you keep accusing me of colluding with the Demonic Path, but what about you? Secretly surveilling fellow disciples, cutting my sister's fate thread—is this the demeanor of Tianqing Sect's former Sect Master?'

dialogue.content: He took out a jade slip from his chest and gently tossed it into the night sky: 'This contains all the evidence of your secret dealings with the Xuanwu Sect, as well as the truth of how you killed my father back then. Ling Yuan, did you really think your ugly secrets could be hidden forever?' His smile grew increasingly gentle, 'After today, everyone under heaven will know your true colors.'

choices.description: Preserve strength, use the terrain and the Tianji Record's foresight ability to escape, seek opportunity to counterattack later.
choices.visible_reward: Escape safely, keep trump cards hidden

text.content: A meaningful smile curled at the corner of Chen Ji's lips as he traced a sinister arc in the void with one hand. Ling Yuan frowned, and in the next moment, the surrounding scenery suddenly distorted—this was the Spacetime Distortion Technique recorded in the Tianji Record Fragment. Though only superficial, it was enough to create an opportunity for escape.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan, your 'kindness,' Chen Ji will remember.' Chen Ji's voice came from the distorted space, carrying a hint of sarcasm, 'Today's matter, I will surely repay generously another day.' The words fell, and the two figures had already vanished into the night.

text.content: Ling Yuan's face was so gloomy it seemed to drip water; he never expected Chen Ji to have such a trick up his sleeve. When did this useless servant disciple master spatial-temporal techniques? "Chase! Chase them down!" His roared echoed through the night sky, "I want to see them alive or see their corpses!"

dialogue.content: Chen Nian leaned against Chen Ji's back, her voice weak but carrying a trace of relief: "Brother... we've seen through Ling Yuan's threads... His fatal point is at the heart position..." Before she could finish, her eyelids had grown too heavy to keep open, "Father... find Father..."

text.content: Chen Ji carried his sister on his back, his eyes blazing like torches as he tore through the darkness at breakneck speed. Tonight carried too much information—the Heavenly Eye was in a chess match with that ancient pair of eyes, the Tianji Pavilion was merely a piece on the ancient eyes' board, and Ling Yuan served as whose lackey remained unclear. But one thing he was certain of: his father was still alive, waiting for him somewhere deep within the temporal rift.
